name: Ahaz
summary: A son of Jotham who ruled Judah for sixteen years and did not do what was right as David had. In his troubles he turned to Assyria's king and to foreign gods, and he shut up the LORD's house.

key_moments.title: Begs Assyria for Help
key_moments.description: When the kings of Syria and Israel came against Jerusalem, Ahaz begged Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria to save him. He sent him silver and gold from the LORD's house, and Assyria attacked Damascus.

key_moments.title: Copies an Altar from Damascus
key_moments.description: Visiting the king of Assyria at Damascus, Ahaz saw an altar there and sent its pattern home. Urijah the priest built a copy, and Ahaz moved the LORD's bronze altar off to one side.

key_moments.title: Shuts the Doors of God's House
key_moments.description: In his distress Ahaz sinned even more, offering sacrifices to the gods of Damascus. He cut up the vessels of God's house, shut its doors, and set up altars all over Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Ask for a Sign
key_moments.description: The LORD told Ahaz to ask for a sign, but Ahaz refused to ask. So the Lord Himself would give a sign: a virgin would have a son, named Immanuel.
